EasyKhata Features

EasyKhata is a ledger and record management app for apartment societies and small businesses in India.

One Pro plan costs Rs 99/month or Rs 999/year and lets an owner manage one Small Business or Apartment khata.

Owners and admins use the Admin Portal to manage the khata. Invited viewers, residents, partners, or members use a limited Viewer / Resident Portal.

Website: www.eazykhata.in

Open App Terms Privacy

Admin and Viewer Portals

  • Owners create one Small Business or Apartment khata and manage it from the Admin Portal.
  • Admins can help manage records, collections, expenses, invoices, reports, settings, and access.
  • Invited viewers, residents, partners, or members see only the khata information shared with them.
  • Users without any granted khata access see a no-access screen after sign in.

Apartment Society Management

  • Track flat-wise monthly maintenance dues and collections.
  • Set and apply maintenance amount to all flats.
  • Record society expenses and download resident-shareable reports.
  • Send payment reminders and receipts over WhatsApp.

Small Business Workflows

  • Record income and expenses with monthly or yearly views.
  • Create invoices and track paid, pending, and overdue status.
  • Manage clients, services, and collection history in one place.

Reports and Export

  • Download PDF reports for monthly and financial-year summaries.
  • Generate share-ready statements for apartment residents and teams.
